notes.title: Demo now available
notes.content:
You can now try Bret Airborne for free!

The demo version includes the following:
[list]
[*]Play the first zone of the campaign
[*]Custom two player local duels
[/list]

Simply click the "Download Demo" button at the right of the screen and start your adventure!
